MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot with Clock and smart plug feels useful because it adds a visible clock and control of another device to the Alexa setup I already use.",
    "The larger Echo Show, portable speaker, and security cameras connect with interests shown in my purchases, although interest alone does not mean I need them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Both Fire TV sticks duplicate the 4K Max bundle I recently bought, and the Echo Show 8 is less compelling after my recent Show 5 and matching stand purchases.",
    "The iPad protector requires a specific device I have not shown that I own, while another wall mount requires a new screen and confirmed fit.",
    "The large subwoofer and older tablet do not address an evident need in my recent purchases of practical accessories and compact Alexa devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Alexa and Fire TV products seems to be treated as a reason to buy more similar devices, even when they repeat functions I just added.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to be stretched into assuming I need accessories for unconfirmed devices or a much larger audio setup."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: the Show 5 stand suggests I am completing that setup, and the 4K Max bundle already fills my streaming need.",
    "Accessories appeal when they fit equipment I own, as with my Harmony replacement batteries and Show stand; compatibility matters more than a broad resemblance.",
    "A clear added function can make another device worthwhile, as with the clock and smart plug, whereas another basic speaker needs a replacement need I have not expressed."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home electronics but miss the difference between adding a useful function and duplicating equipment I already have."
}
